# EcoSapien — Paper, thread, and wire

> Artist portfolio across watercolour, charcoal, embroidery and filigree-wire jewellery.

- [Portfolio](https://www.ecosapien.de/): selected work and practice introduction.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/eco-sapien/site): static GitHub Pages website.

The current gallery identifies its collections as being prepared; artwork photographs have not yet been added. Do not infer artworks or exhibition history from these collection placeholders.
